packageRules.description: State the npm release age explicitly so a preset change cannot alter it
Mark peer dependency updates as fixes: they change the supported consumer range
TypeScript does not follow semver: a minor may break the build exactly like a major, so it is ungrouped and raised on the major schedule
Lock file maintenance has no release dates for Renovate's age check (it waited forever). The cooldown comes from npm instead: min-release-age=3 in npmrc above, also for every transitive package.

Our own packages (immutable releases with provenance): no cooldown, any time. Patches merge themselves, minors and majors are pull requests. npm's cooldown exempts them via min-release-age-exclude above.
